notes.title: Update Notes for December 20
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued feedback and support! We've been working hard to address your suggestions and improve the gameplay experience.

---

[h2]Main Updates[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [b]Main Screen Speed:[/b] Slowed down the main screen transitions for a smoother user experience.
[*] [b]Death Screen Timer:[/b] Increased the death screen duration from 3 seconds to 5 seconds to give players more time.
[/olist]

---

[h2]Level-Specific Changes[/h2]

[h3]Umm Alsibyan[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Camera Bug:[/b] Fixed a bug where the camera would clip into houses.
[*] [b]Sign Arrows:[/b] Added arrows pointing to the first sign and the first checkpoint for improved navigation.
[*] [b]Voice Volume:[/b] Increased Umm Alsibyan’s voice to make it more audible.
[*] [b]Sign Placement:[/b] Adjusted the locations of signs to reduce spam interactions when placing objects.
[/olist]

[h3]Bu Duryah[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Dashing After Water:[/b] Removed the ability to dash after jumping out of water. This change enhances the challenge and balance of the level by removing the previous single "bugged dash."
[*] [b]Shark Health:[/b] Sharks now have 1 health point, making them easier to defeat.
[*] [b]Water Voice:[/b] Lowered the volume of water sounds and limited the number of objects that trigger the sound.
[*] [b]Barrel Physics:[/b] Fixed the weird falling behavior of barrels.
[/olist]

[h3]Napping Donkey[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]First Puzzle:[/b] Added a message to make the first puzzle easier to solve.
[*] [b]Climbing Challenge:[/b] Improved the climbing mechanics for a smoother experience.
[/olist]

[h3]Umm Alduwais[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Bird Size:[/b] Increased the size of birds to make landing on them easier.
[*] [b]Kill Zone Bug:[/b] Resolved an issue where players would lose multiple lives in kill zones by adding insta-kill zones for clarity and consistency.
[/olist]

---

[h2]General Improvements[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [b]Interaction Buttons:[/b] Changed the "Chat & Pickup" button to `E` for easier reach.
[*] [b]Respawn Boxes:[/b] Ensured dropped boxes respawn in water levels.
[*] [b]Main Menu Mini-Game:[/b] Optimized the mini-game in the main menu and made it optional.
[*] [b]Sound Controls:[/b] Added a new option for players to adjust sound levels and control audio settings.
[/olist]

---

We hope these updates enhance your experience! Keep sharing your thoughts and stay tuned for more improvements. 💡

notes.title: Update Notes for November 13
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued feedback and support! Here are the latest updates and improvements:

[b]Boss Levels:[/b]
[olist]
[*] The timer now stops during conversations in boss levels, so you can take your time reading without the pressure of a countdown.
[/olist]
[b]Umm Alduwais:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added gameplay tips to help clarify objectives, as some players found the gameplay a bit confusing.
[*] Fixed a bug where lives could go into negative values.
[*] Updated the sleep bar icon to better reflect its status, clearly showing when it’s full, and when the player wins.
[/olist]
[b]General Improvements:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added Emirati Arabic voice-over to signs, similar to the existing voice-over for regular conversations.
[*] Conversation audio now stops when moving away from characters, creating a more seamless experience.
[/olist]

Keep sharing your thoughts, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 10
notes.content:
Thank you for all your feedback and support! I've made several updates to improve the gameplay experience based on your input:

[b]Umm Alduwais:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Limited the number of birds that can spawn at any given time to avoid overwhelming players.
[*] Reduced the bird spawn rate slightly.
[*] Added a new dialogue for when players lose due to not defeating birds quickly enough, giving clearer feedback on the reason for defeat.
[/olist]
[b]The Tale of Greed:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the whales to be less challenging.
[*] Increased the speed of boats for a smoother experience.
[*] Sharks are now pushed back when hit, adding a bit more control during encounters.
[*] Reduced the number of coins available in the level for a balanced challenge.
[/olist]
[b]The Napping Donkey[/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a rendering issue where some rocks would disappear unexpectedly.
[/olist]
[b]Overall Edits[/b]
[olist]
[*] Your falcon now collect stars, but not all of them.
[*] Game sounds are now muted when pausing the game.
[*] Fixed the boss level cards, which now correctly display without showing coin counts.
[/olist]

Keep sharing your thoughts, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 5
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has tried the game and shared your feedback! Your comments and support mean a lot to me, and I’m excited to keep improving the game with your help. Here are the latest updates based on your feedback:

[olist]
[*] [b]Improved Spin Hitbox[/b] – I've adjusted the hitbox for the spin move, making it easier to land attacks accurately.
[*] [b]Bu Duryah Level Progression Fix[/b] – Fixed an issue in Bu Duryah level where players were sometimes not advanced to the next level upon completion. This should now work smoothly.
[*] [b]Sea Level Skip Fix[/b] – A workaround that allowed players to skip the sea level has been addressed. Apologies if this removes a fun trick, but I’m keeping the adventure challenging!
[/olist]
Keep sharing your thoughts, and stay tuned for more updates!
